title: Elon Musk builds Terra Fab, the world’s largest chip factory boosting #elonmusk #terrafab #aitech
description: Elon Musk is building the Terra Fab, the largest building in human history, designed to manufacture chips on an unprecedented scale. The facility will be three times the size of Central Park, spanning 1,700 football fields, to meet the massive chip demands for Tesla, SpaceX, Grok, and Optimus. Due to current chip supply constraints, Musk secured all possible inventories from major suppliers, yet that accounts for only 2% of his needs. Terra Fab aims to produce 200 billion AI chips annually, ramping up production fiftyfold compared to today’s levels. These chips will primarily support space-based orbital data centers, powering global AI infrastructure from orbit. Terra Fab represents a paradigm shift in semiconductor manufacturing to sustain next-generation AI and space technologies. #elonmusk #terrafab #tesla #spacex #optimusrobot #aichips #semiconductormanufacturing #aiinfrastructure #spacedatacenters #chipshortage #technologyinnovation #grokaitech #futureofai #orbitaldatacenters #techscaleup
